subject.title: [Feature]: Make workboard dispatch maxStarts configurable and parallelize per-card start loop

question: Should the remaining Workboard dispatch scope stay limited to the linked CLI/RPC `maxStarts` path, or should maintainers also accept persistent config and parallel per-card starts for this issue?
rationale: The source gap is real, but persistent config adds a new plugin config contract and parallel starts change resource/concurrency behavior that repository policy treats as product-sensitive.

options.title: Accept narrow CLI/RPC first
options.body: Review the linked PR as the default-preserving first step and keep or split the config/parallelism remainder for explicit follow-up.

options.title: Approve full dispatch tuning scope
options.body: Authorize a broader implementation that adds plugin-owned config plus parallel start semantics with upgrade, docs, and concurrency proof.

options.title: Decline config and parallel starts
options.body: Treat the CLI/RPC flag as sufficient and close the remaining config/parallel request after the linked PR lands or is otherwise resolved.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow CLI/RPC first
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR as the default-preserving first step and keep or split the config/parallelism remainder for explicit follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The Workboard worker dispatch CLI and docs were introduced through steipete-authored/merged history, making this the clearest product-scope routing candidate.
